iso_retirement.comment:
Juergen Burkhardt's preliminary historical-comparative analysis confirms Blust’s
(1974) classfication, which claims:

Berawan (a separate group of languages)

West-Berawan (= Berawan Long Terawan)

Central-East Berawan

- Central Berawan (Batu Belah & Long Teru)

- East Berawan (Long Jegan)
iso_retirement.name: Berawan
iso_retirement.remedy: Split into three languages: West Berawan [zbw], Central Berawan [zbc], and East Berawan [zbe]
